description: Cyber Physical Monitoring Dataset for a BESS Integrated Distribution Grid Hardware-in-the-Loop Testbed is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Md Fazley Rafy. "This dataset contains time-stamped cyber-physical monitoring records generated from a battery energy storage system (BESS) integrated distribution-grid hardware-in-the-loop testbed. The dataset was developed from simulated operating scenarios based on a testbed combining distribution-feeder simulation, inverter and battery emulation, edge-controller communication, and logging. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
